views.speaker: Lu Xun
views.view: Human warmth — Bajie's gluttony and lust are the best footnote to the idea that gods and demons all possess human feeling

views.speaker: Lin Yutang
views.view: The archetype of desire — Bajie is the shadow archetype in Jungian psychology, a microcosm of the real working person

views.speaker: Mao Zedong
views.view: Hard work and pragmatism — despite his flaws, Bajie completes the journey, a model of the pragmatic worker
